CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_BankTransactionAdministration] AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC


WITH Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration AS (
SELECT
TRAN_DATE as TransactionTimestamp
,TRAN_ID as TransactionId
,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM as TransactionPartSerialNum
,BANK_ID as FinancialInstitutionId
,LCHG_TIME as AdministrationTimestamp
,'Modify' as AdministrationTypeId
,LCHG_USER_ID as EmployeeId
,'DEP' as SourceSystemCode
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE
WHERE isLatest = 1

Union

SELECT
TRAN_DATE as TransactionTimestamp
,TRAN_ID as TransactionId
,PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM as TransactionPartSerialNum
,BANK_ID as FinancialInstitutionId
,RCRE_TIME as AdministrationTimestamp
,'Create' as AdministrationTypeId
,RCRE_USER_ID as EmployeeId
,'DEP' as SourceSystemCode
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM busc.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE
WHERE isLatest = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration FROM Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration;


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH 
Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_SRC
AS(
SELECT
TransactionTimestamp
,TransactionId
,TransactionPartSerialNum
,FinancialInstitutionId
,AdministrationTimestamp
,AdministrationTypeId
,SourceSystemCode 
FROM #Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
)
,
Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_TGT
AS(
SELECT
TransactionTimestamp
,TransactionId
,TransactionPartSerialNum
,FinancialInstitutionId
,AdministrationTimestamp
,AdministrationTypeId
,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.BankTransactionAdministration
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
)
,
Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
ISNULL(SRC.TransactionTimeStamp,TGT.TransactionTimeStamp) AS TransactionTimeStamp
,ISNULL(SRC.TransactionId,TGT.TransactionId) AS TransactionId
,ISNULL(SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum,TGT.TransactionPartSerialNum) AS TransactionPartSerialNum
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.AdministrationTimestamp,TGT.AdministrationTimestamp) AS AdministrationTimestamp
,ISNULL(SRC.AdministrationTypeId,TGT.AdministrationTypeId) AS AdministrationTypeId

FROM Temp_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_TGT TGT
ON SRC.TransactionId = TGT.TransactionId
AND SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum = TGT.TransactionPartSerialNum
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.AdministrationTimestamp = TGT.AdministrationTimestamp
AND SRC.AdministrationTypeId = TGT.AdministrationTypeId
WHERE TGT.TransactionTimestamp IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_DELTA;


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.BankTransactionAdministration(
TransactionTimestamp
,TransactionId
,TransactionPartSerialNum
,FinancialInstitutionId
,AdministrationTimestamp
,AdministrationTypeId
,EmployeeId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
) SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.TransactionTimestamp
,SRC.TransactionId
,SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.AdministrationTimestamp
,SRC.AdministrationTypeId
,EmployeeId
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM  #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_DELTA DLT
ON DLT.TransactionTimeStamp = SRC.TransactionTimeStamp
AND DLT.TransactionId = SRC.TransactionId
AND DLT.TransactionPartSerialNum = SRC.TransactionPartSerialNum
AND DLT.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DLT.AdministrationTimestamp = SRC.AdministrationTimestamp
AND DLT.AdministrationTypeId = SRC.AdministrationTypeId

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_BankTransactionAdministration_DELTA;

END
GO
